title: ageratina sotarensis
intro: Ageratina sotarensis, commonly known as Sotarensis Mint, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as relief from inflammation, pain, and fever. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina sotarensis have been studied for their antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential source of natural remedies for various health conditions.
